Sample Company Leave Policy
Purpose
This policy outlines the guidelines for employee leave, including annual, sick, and casual leave, to
ensure fair and consistent application across the company. Annual Leave
Employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued monthly. Leave
must be approved by a manager at least 3 days in advance. Sick Leave
Employees may take up to 10 paid sick leave days per year.

A medical certificate is required for
absences longer than 2 consecutive days. Casual Leave
5 days of casual leave are available per year for personal matters, subject to manager approval.

Sample Company Remote Work Policy
Purpose
This policy sets expectations for employees working remotely, ensuring productivity, security, and clear
communication. Eligibility
Employees who have completed 3 months of employment and whose role does not require physical
presence may apply for remote work. Working Hours
Remote employees are expected to be available during core hours of 10 AM to 4 PM local time and
attend all scheduled meetings. Equipment & Security
Employees must use company-approved devices and a secure VPN connection when accessing
company systems remotely.
